newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian wool prices expected firm.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian wool prices expected firm.

text.p: Australian wool prices are expected to remain firm at auctions in Sydney, Launceston and Fremantle this week when about 77,600 bales will be offered, Wesfarmers Dalgety Ltd said in its weekly market preview.

A slightly smaller and less stylish selection will be offered in Sydney. In Launceston there is a large stylish offering, including a proportion of spinners style clips that are well grown and sound. Fremantle also has a larger offering.
The eastern market indicator rose by 16 cents to 608 cents a kg clean last week, while the western market indicator rose nine cent to 582 cents a kg clean.
Wesfarmers said last week's price movement was encouraging with all micron categories steadily gaining strength.
"This positive sentiment is expected to remain this week, maintaining the upward pressure on prices," Wesfarmers said.
Wesfarmers said the slight strengthening of the Australian dollar by one U.S. cent may dampen upward price movement for the broader end of the market.
However prices for finer wools (particularly stylish clips) are expected to be firm with the last of these types for the season available over the next two weeks.
